name: plan-item-context
about: An item filed from a plan gets the plan's approved documents (item #90). Piece 1 of the blueprint points at a section outside it ('the names in Shared names'), which item #78 had to ask the user to paste. For triage, build and review of the piece, the runner writes the approved blueprint and brief (the versions the user approved, by number, checked against their sha256) to .loop/context/blueprint.md and brief.md, lists them under the context with their version and sha, and the brief says: your piece is in the ask, the whole blueprint is there for the sections it points at, do not ask for what it contains. The fake agent reads blueprint.md (its stream shows the Shared names section). An item not from a plan gets neither.
